$Comment: The skeleton every Harvest Feast contract inherits through Parent. It is never posted.
Season hides every contract built on it while the feast is off; a child that writes its own
Requires keeps it, since Season is a leaf of its own. Listing files each one with the contracts.
Rewards.Auto is what every job on the feast board pays the moment the work is done: the board's pay
table, a little favor with the host and a little Festival Favor. A child that writes Rewards
replaces the list whole. A child names its board and band in Boards and its work in Objectives, and
takes its words from the keys its id spells (quest.<id>.title and .flavor).
